face.name: 迪菲亚头目
face.text: 连击：&召唤一个2/1的迪菲亚强盗。
face.flavorText: 他在数年前偷走了地契，所以理论上说这片地盘确实是他的。他还喜欢用“白痴”称呼别人，显得自己很有势力。

face.name: Defias Ringleader
face.flavorText: He stole the deed to town years ago, so technically the town is his. He just calls people Scrub to be mean.

face.name: 潜踪大师奥普
face.text: 潜行。战吼，连击，亡语：&施放刀扇。
face.flavorText: 据说奥普就长这个样子。我们会进一步确认他的形象——如果我们有机会见到他的话。

face.name: Opu the Unseen
face.text: Stealth. Battlecry, Combo, and Deathrattle:& Cast 'Fan of Knives'.
face.flavorText: This is allegedly what Opu looks like. We will confirm if we ever see him.

face.name: 刀扇
face.text: 对所有敌方随从造成 1点伤害，抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: 转瞬即逝的寒光闪过，漫天飞舞的血花绽放。

face.name: Fan of Knives
face.text: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions. Draw a card.
face.flavorText: I wouldn't say I LOVE knives, but I'm definitely a fan.

face.name: 黑市拍卖师
face.text: 预备。每当你施放一个法术，&抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: 只有我这儿才有最好的赃物买卖！

face.name: Black Market Auctioneer

face.flavorText: I got the best steals anywhere!
